prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: fictional creative agency portfolio concept, landscape 1536x1024 PNG.
Primary request: Create a striking integrated creative digital system for TRAMA, a fictional cultural events platform. A tangible large printed poster on the left and an elegant desktop website presentation on a thin unbranded dark monitor on the right, with one small mobile responsive screen standing forward of the monitor. Everything is staged together as a purposeful studio artwork on a quiet near-black surface, not a tiled moodboard. The poster and website share a strong original typographic TRAMA wordmark, a precise modular grid and a rhythmic abstract interwoven stripe motif. Poster printed in vivid ultramarine with electric chartreuse typography. Website features a crisp cream navigation, a large ultramarine hero with chartreuse statement text, and three tidy event cards with abstract graphic artwork underneath. Mobile screen presents the same functional system as a narrow layout. Believable tactile paper, subtle shadows, fully legible high-fidelity screen graphics.
Palette: ultramarine #233DFF, chartreuse #DBF85A, black #101010, small warm-white areas.
Text (verbatim): "TRAMA", "CULTURA EN MOVIMIENTO", "AGENDA", "MÚSICA", "ARTE", "ENCUENTROS", "EXPLORAR". Use only these short words where needed; avoid illegible paragraph filler.
Composition/framing: landscape editorial composition, poster dominates left 40%, desktop screen right 60%, mobile overlaps lower right, crop close so the designs fill the frame, powerful but disciplined typography with clear hierarchy.
Constraints: fictional concept, no real brand logos, no fake customers, testimonials, results, awards or partnerships; no existing brand copying; no agency webpage frame; no humans. This image illustrates a conceptual project and must not imply an actual client engagement.
